# GitLab

> GitLab is an AI-powered DevSecOps platform for planning, building, securing, and deploying software in a single application.

GitLab combines source code management, CI/CD, security, package and container registries, project planning, observability, and AI-assisted workflows. Its public documentation spans product docs, API references, administration guides, development handbooks, and engineering blog content across gitlab.com and about.gitlab.com.

## Product Documentation

- [GitLab Documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/): Main documentation hub for using, administering, and developing with GitLab.
- [Get started](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/get_started/): Introductory guides for onboarding to GitLab features and workflows.
- [User documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/): End-user docs for projects, groups, issues, merge requests, and collaboration.
- [CI/CD documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/): Reference and guides for pipelines, runners, variables, and pipeline configuration.
- [Security documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/application_security/): Docs for application security testing, policies, and vulnerability management.
- [GitLab Duo documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/gitlab_duo/): Documentation for GitLab’s AI features across the software lifecycle.
- [Administration documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/administration/): Self-managed installation, configuration, scaling, backup, and maintenance guidance.
- [Topics documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/topics/): Cross-cutting docs for integrations, workflows, and specialized product areas.

## API Reference

- [REST API](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/): Complete REST API reference for projects, groups, pipelines, users, and more.
- [GraphQL API](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/graphql/): GraphQL API overview, schema access, and query examples.
- [CI/CD pipeline triggers API](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/pipeline_triggers/): Trigger pipelines programmatically using tokens and API requests.
- [Jobs API](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/jobs/): Manage CI/CD jobs, traces, artifacts, and job lifecycle operations.
- [Merge requests API](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/merge_requests/): Create, review, update, and automate merge request workflows.
- [Projects API](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/projects/): Manage project settings, metadata, visibility, and repository-related operations.
- [Groups API](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/groups/): Work with groups, memberships, subgroups, and group-level configuration.
- [Personal access tokens API](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/personal_access_tokens/): Inspect and manage personal access tokens through the API.

## CI/CD and DevOps Guides

- [GitLab CI/CD YAML syntax reference](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/yaml/): Full reference for `.gitlab-ci.yml` keywords and pipeline configuration.
- [Auto DevOps](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/topics/autodevops/): Automatically build, test, secure, and deploy applications with minimal configuration.
- [GitLab Runner](https://docs.gitlab.com/runner/): Install, configure, and operate GitLab Runner for CI/CD execution.
- [Review apps](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/review_apps/): Create dynamic environments for previewing changes before deployment.
- [Environments and deployments](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/environments/): Manage deployment targets, environments, and release workflows.
- [Pipeline efficiency](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/pipelines/pipeline_efficiency/): Optimize pipeline speed, resource usage, and execution reliability.
- [Caching](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/caching/): Reuse dependencies and build outputs to accelerate pipelines.
- [Job artifacts](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/jobs/job_artifacts/): Store, browse, and pass build outputs between pipeline jobs.

## Source Code Management and Collaboration

- [Projects](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/): Manage repositories, settings, access, integrations, and project-level workflows.
- [Groups](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/group/): Organize teams and projects with shared permissions and governance.
- [Issues](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/issues/): Track work, bugs, and requirements with issue management features.
- [Merge requests](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/merge_requests/): Collaborate on code review, approvals, and branch integration.
- [Code review](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/merge_requests/reviews/): Review changes with comments, suggestions, and approval workflows.
- [Wiki](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/wiki/): Maintain project documentation directly within GitLab repositories.
- [Snippets](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/snippets/): Share reusable code and text snippets across users and projects.
- [Web IDE](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/web_ide/): Edit code in-browser with integrated source control and review workflows.

## Security, Compliance, and Governance

- [Application security](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/application_security/): Overview of GitLab security scanners and vulnerability management capabilities.
- [SAST](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/application_security/sast/): Static application security testing for source code vulnerabilities.
- [DAST](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/application_security/dast/): Dynamic application security testing for running web applications.
- [Dependency scanning](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/application_security/dependency_scanning/): Detect vulnerable dependencies in application manifests and lockfiles.
- [Container scanning](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/application_security/container_scanning/): Scan container images for known vulnerabilities before deployment.
- [Security policies](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/application_security/policies/): Define and enforce scan execution and approval policies.
- [Compliance management](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/compliance/): Manage frameworks, controls, reporting, and audit-related workflows.
- [Protected branches](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/repository/branches/protected/): Restrict branch changes to enforce governance and release controls.

## Packages, Registries, and Artifacts

- [Package Registry](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/packages/package_registry/): Publish and consume packages from GitLab-hosted package registries.
- [Container Registry](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/packages/container_registry/): Store, manage, and secure container images alongside source code.
- [Maven packages](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/packages/maven_repository/): Use GitLab as a Maven package repository.
- [npm packages](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/packages/npm_registry/): Publish and install JavaScript packages with the npm registry.
- [PyPI packages](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/packages/pypi_repository/): Host and distribute Python packages through GitLab.
- [Terraform module registry](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/packages/terraform_module_registry/): Publish and consume Terraform modules in GitLab.
- [Generic packages](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/packages/generic_packages/): Upload arbitrary versioned files as generic packages.
- [Release artifacts](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/releases/): Create releases with evidence, assets, and version metadata.

## Administration and Self-Managed

- [Install GitLab](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/install/): Installation options for self-managed GitLab deployments.
- [Omnibus GitLab](https://docs.gitlab.com/omnibus/): Linux package installation, configuration, and operations documentation.
- [Helm chart](https://docs.gitlab.com/charts/): Deploy GitLab to Kubernetes using the official Helm chart.
- [Reference architectures](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/administration/reference_architectures/): Recommended deployment topologies for scale, performance, and availability.
- [Backup and restore](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/administration/backup_restore/): Protect and recover GitLab data in self-managed environments.
- [Authentication and authorization](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/administration/auth/): Configure LDAP, SAML, OAuth, and other identity integrations.
- [Monitoring GitLab](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/administration/monitoring/): Observe GitLab health, metrics, logs, and performance.
- [Upgrade GitLab](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/update/): Plan and execute version upgrades safely.

## Development and Contributing

- [GitLab Development Kit](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/development/contributing/development_kit/): Local development environment for contributing to GitLab.
- [Contribute to GitLab](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/development/contributing/): Contributor guidance for code, documentation, and merge request workflows.
- [Developer documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/development/): Internal architecture, backend, frontend, and engineering development docs.
- [API style guide](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/development/api_styleguide/): Standards for designing and maintaining GitLab APIs.
- [Database guides](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/development/database/): Documentation for migrations, schema design, and database practices.
- [Frontend development](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/development/fe_guide/): Frontend architecture, Vue patterns, and UI development guidance.
- [Testing standards and style guidelines](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/development/testing_guide/): Testing approaches and conventions for GitLab contributors.
- [Documentation guidelines](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/development/documentation/): Standards for writing and maintaining GitLab documentation.

## Company Handbook and Engineering

- [GitLab Handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/): Public company handbook covering processes, teams, and operating principles.
- [Engineering handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/): Engineering organization structure, practices, and responsibilities.
- [Product handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/product/): Product management principles, planning, and team processes.
- [Marketing handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/marketing/): Public documentation of GitLab marketing programs and operations.
- [Values](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/values/): GitLab’s company values and expected behaviors.
- [All-remote](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/all-remote/): Guidance and principles for operating as an all-remote company.
- [Communication](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/communication/): Communication norms, channels, and collaboration practices.
- [Security handbook](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/): Security team responsibilities, practices, and operational guidance.

## Blog, Releases, and Learn

- [GitLab Blog](https://about.gitlab.com/blog/): Articles on product updates, engineering, security, and DevSecOps practices.
- [Releases](https://about.gitlab.com/releases/): Monthly GitLab release posts summarizing new features and improvements.
- [Direction](https://about.gitlab.com/direction/): Product direction pages outlining strategy and planned investments.
- [Learn](https://about.gitlab.com/learn/): Educational resources on DevSecOps, CI/CD, security, and software delivery.
- [Customer stories](https://about.gitlab.com/customers/): Case studies showing how organizations use GitLab in practice.
- [Events](https://about.gitlab.com/events/): Upcoming webinars, conferences, and GitLab-hosted events.
- [Topics](https://about.gitlab.com/topics/): Topical content hubs for DevOps, security, AI, and related subjects.
- [The Source](https://about.gitlab.com/the-source/): Editorial content and perspectives on software development and DevSecOps.
